notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for resign-time ordinary object-removal fan-out. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies two registered objects discovered by two active subscribers, publisher resignation with DELETE_OBJECTS, two removal callbacks per subscriber in producer order with empty resign tags, preservation of object and producing-federate metadata, and suppression of owner loopback. Timestamped removal, regions/DDM, custom transportation, MOM, save/restore, and provider-private behavior remain outside this contract.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador object-class lookup, publication, active subscription, object registration, DELETE_OBJECTS resignation, unsubscription, federation destruction, and disconnect services with FederateAmbassador discovery and ordinary removal callbacks
